holistic_visual_review: All 21 native frames and enlarged f10/f15/f20 crops: beta1 preserves dancer and rooftop throughout, like baseline and beta0.5, and pushes raised hand somewhat forward. Face/hand remain soft and orbit still modest. Stronger beta does not clearly improve whole-video quality over beta0.5 or baseline; late-arm mean error is nonmonotonic (41.62 -> 37.99 -> 39.18 px for beta0/0.5/1), with contrast trend below baseline at both nonzero settings.
caveat: Pose detector has known left/right knee confusion in beta0.5; full visual assessment controls. These are only one source window and target angle.
keypoint_tracking: beta0.5 official DWPose knee labels collapse at f10/f20 despite visible raised leg, while beta1 detects separated knees; therefore all-joint aggregate across variants is not a reliable ranking metric.
